The '''Rescue on Arkinnea''' took place several months after the creation of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The [[Whiphid/Legends|Whiphid]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[K'Kruhk]], after crash landing on [[Arkinnea]] from an attack on a jungle moon, protected his students from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], more specifically the [[Arkinnea Militia]], and established a [[Hidden Temple]] on the planet with the aid of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Denimoor]] and [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Teron]], who did not believe [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] [[Declaration of a New Order|claims]] that the Jedi Order had turned traitor against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].
